name: Code
purpose: A few lines of code or terminal commands typed out as they're explained, with one line pointed out.
use_when: the source shows code, a command, a formula or a config to copy
a technical how-to: what to run and what it does
avoid_when: code that isn't in the source: copy it exactly, never invent commands or output
more than 10 lines (show the part that matters)

title.desc: File name or window title, e.g. 'settings.yaml' or 'Terminal'

code.desc: One line per item, copied exactly (indent with spaces). In the terminal layout start commands with '$ '; other lines are output

highlight.desc: Index of the line the note is about

editor.desc: A code editor window with line numbers

terminal.desc: A terminal: commands type out after the prompt, output lines follow

example.headline: Turn on two-step sign-in
example.title: Terminal
code: Scan the QR code with your app.
example.note: This one command turns it on for your account.

example_beats.say: Open a terminal, sign in, and turn on two-step sign-in.
That second command is the one that matters: it switches it on for your account.
